results.title: India's Free Trade Agreements Could Boost GDP By $170 Billion By 2035
results.description: India's expanding free trade agreements could increase GDP by $140 billion to $170 billion by 2035, according to Bloomberg Economics. The report expects diversified export markets to cushion higher US tariffs, while new trade partnerships could boost investment and productivity. Artificial intelligence could further support economic growth over time

results.title: Nikam backs Prahaar casting; lawyer says he was won over on set
results.description: Ujjwal Nikam, who knew nothing of Rajkummar Rao before “Prahaar,” says he asked, “Who is this Rajkummar?” when told Rao would play him. After meeting the actor on set, he called him “a real actor.” The film releases October 16, and Rao’s next biopic is “Dada.”
